professionalSummary.text: Gathers requirements from field technicians and depot staff, translating them into user stories and testable acceptance criteria.
professionalSummary.witness: Gathered requirements from field technicians and the depot team through ride-alongs and depot visits, and wrote the user stories and acceptance criteria for the offline checklist and parts-scan features of the technician app.

experienceHighlights.text: Organizes acceptance rounds with technicians on the app and keeps the results.
experienceHighlights.witness: Organised acceptance rounds for four app releases at the training site with a rotating group of technicians, and kept the results per criterion in a shared sheet.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Collaborates with engineering and field-service managers to settle release scope and decision-making responsibilities.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Coordinated release scope with the engineering lead and the field-service manager in the release planning meeting; the engineering lead decided scope and dates, and the field-service manager approved the rollout order across regions.

skills.text: Documents limitations and trainer hand-over steps for every app release.
skills.witness: Wrote up each app release for the regional trainers, flagging that parts-scan only worked on the newer handheld model and listing the steps trainers had to take over.
